sections.body: Direction phrases turn a vague travel problem into a specific next step. sections.body: If the answer is long, ask them to point or type it. Street directions can be hard to catch by ear.

sections.body: Show the map or address first, then ask the phrase. The answer is easier to understand when both of you see the same place.
